info.title: Aegis Gateway REST API
info.description:
Security gateway for AI agent data access with minimum disclosure controls.

## Authentication
Two methods supported (use either as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`):
1. **API Key** (recommended for Dify/n8n): Use the API key directly as Bearer token
2. **JWT**: Exchange API key via `POST /auth/token` for a short-lived JWT

## Core Principles (Absolute Order)
- **AO-001**: All data access passes through this gateway
- **AO-002**: Minimum disclosure — only requested scope is returned
- **AO-003**: Every access is recorded in a tamper-evident audit chain
- **AO-004**: Capsule integrity is preserved across lifecycle
- **AO-005**: Host binding prevents unauthorized environments
- **AO-006**: No secrets in code — all via capsules/env
